requirements: R1: The ATM starts in Idle.
R2: Inserting a card from Idle moves to Authenticating.
R3: A valid PIN from Authenticating moves to Ready.
R4: An invalid PIN from Authenticating returns to Idle.
R5: Selecting withdraw from Ready moves to Dispensing.
R6: Dispense complete from Dispensing returns to Ready.
R7: Ejecting the card from Ready returns to Idle.
R8: Card insert is rejected while Ready.
